messages.subject: For Josu Jon Imaz | Government relations, ESG and international energy strategy
messages.body:
Dear Repsol Press and Communications Team,

Please place this executive introduction before Mr. Josu Jon Imaz, Chief Executive Officer, where appropriate.

Repsol's international portfolio operates across energy security, transition, regulation, community expectations and government relationships. Those priorities closely match the external leadership work I manage today.

I serve as Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department at AGM Inc., part of Zijin Mining Group. My mandate spans government and regulatory relations, ESG, corporate affairs, strategic partnerships and executive advisory across complex resource operations and renewable-energy initiatives.

I would welcome a senior conversation regarding roles where this combination of government relations, ESG execution and emerging-market stakeholder leadership could support Repsol internationally. My attached CV has been tailored specifically to Repsol.

Kind regards,
Ragunauth Ramsaroop
Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department | AGM Inc.
